# compact

common

open suspend override fun [compact](compact.html)(session: [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html), sessionService: [SessionService](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/index.html))

Compacts events in the given session. If compaction happened, the new compaction event will be appended to the given [sessionService](../-event-compactor/compact.html).

#### Parameters

 _session_

The session containing the events to be compacted.

_session Service_

The session service used to append the produced compaction event.
